role: wave 10, domain 8 (dense/sparse CC bombers, early INT86 heavy bombs), R5-cost (audit + combination screen)
audit: Domain-8 fixes proposed so far: B088 mix4 (zero-byte per-battle mixed lattice 22h/32h/42h/52h from [4A17h]&3; only defense ever built for this domain). B058/B068: early INT86 bombs ~2% of deaths, no cheap fix (only image size). Real field bombers (IND_BRA, R1DDLE, tson) are lattice-blind (B068/B088). Best = mix4 (works vs the purpose-built 52h bomber, zero bytes in rev0). Combination partner: KP (B094 = K_A + KP_B), the only candidate whose confirm passed the pooled gate. K's SD removed the dead mov dx,[4A17h] from phoenix_init, so mix4 needs that read back (+1 turn, +4 bytes per side); KPt is the turn-only control so that KPm-KP splits into timing and lattice parts. Pairing helper: agent2/night/scratch/B098/pair.cjs (per-cohort cand-minus-cand on identical base values; KP reference = B094 screen c08bm).

threatFindings.threat: Early INT86 heavy bombs at startup
threatFindings.evidence: Not re-tested; B058 pkj3o (~2% of deaths), B068 ogq11 (~-0.007/bomb). KP images (196/222 B) and KPm (200/226 B) are larger than rev0 (194/202 B).
threatFindings.impact: Larger image is a slightly larger target: hypothesis, no job spent.

recommendation: Do not promote mix4, alone or inside KP. Ported onto KP (KPm) it keeps its defense vs the purpose-built 52h bomber (+0.66) but loses -0.325 vs a 22h bomber and -0.548 vs a [4A17h]-reading bomber, and its general cost is now resolved: KPm-KP -0.025 [-0.047,-0.003] on field S (strong -0.12, 2025 -0.019, both lo<0), of which about -0.016 is the mixed lattice and -0.009 the re-added phoenix_init turn. The bomber threat it answers does not exist in any field. Keep KP (without mix4) as the combination target; do not reintroduce the dead mov dx,[4A17h] that SD removed. Domain 8 stays closed for field purposes; a private-coin lattice would still pay the strong-group lattice cost and is not worth a job.
